context: Riku tells Aoi about winning a tough match.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (優勝/困難/不足/たび/起きる) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昨日の試合、優勝したんだ!
lines.style: excited teen boy voice, bright warm eager delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: おめでとう!困難な相手だったの?
lines.en: Congrats! Was it a tough opponent?
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delighted delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、すごく困難な試合だったよ。
lines.en: Yeah, it was a really tough match.
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 練習不足は、なかったの?
lines.style: curious barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 練習不足を、気合いで補ったよ。
lines.en: We made up for the practice shortage with spirit.
lines.style: proud teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 試合のたびに、強くなるね。
lines.en: You get stronger with each match.
lines.style: warm barista voice, soft warm admiring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 逆転が起きた時、最高だったよ!
lines.en: When the comeback happened, it was the best!
lines.style: thrilled teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 優勝のたびに、教えてね!
lines.en: Tell me every time you win!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm closing delivery throughout
